It's been nice to chill and vibe to and maybe watch a movie on the side, but sadly there are now lots and lots of bots and scammers around that ruin the experience for legit players.
The bot problem especially has grown so out of hand that it's nearly impossible to mine ore on a f2p server on a new account.
Wilderness is full of bots that scout you when you enter and you're killed even if you're not carrying anything valuable.
Items and resources are botted so much they become worthless and bonds are ridiculously expensive because they are in such a high demand by all the bot farms.
In Grand exchange all you see is bots spamming gp selling sites and other bots running some elaborate scams. And that's just the tip of the iceberg.
Jagex are trying to keep the hope alive by introducing some new content from time to time, but you're just constantly reminded of how bad the situation has become.
For that reason I can sadly not recommend this game.

Old School RuneScape is a delight to play. The pixel art style and 2D interface bring back nostalgic memories of classic RPGs. The game's focus on player choice and freedom is refreshing and the community is friendly and helpful. The game boasts a surprising amount of content, with numerous quests, skills, and mini-games to keep players entertained for hours on end. The only downside is the game's somewhat dated graphics and limited character customization options. Overall, Old School RuneScape is a wonderful throwback to classic RPGs and a joy to play.

I played this game for 21 years, since I was 14 years old. It might seem strange to write a negative review on a game I've loved, however my 21 year old account has been permanently banned due to a false positive for botting software. I have no idea what software has been falsely detected, but I'm heartbroken that this has happened. Without any real dialogue or explanation, they give you ONE appeal chance - a chance I took and have been denied. During this time I was paying for membership for most of the years, including the months AFTER my account was permanently banned during a break in play. No consideration of that, or why I would continue to pay. For your own sake, avoid playing this game so you can avoid having something like this happen to you. I feel like a piece of my childhood has been robbed.

I've went back to my roots of playing my nostalgia hit OSRS days. I made a UIM (Ultimate Ironman) account in order to really delve deep into the game and relearn it. I used to just pay to acquire the things I needed quickly, and making this account has really helped me curb my spending habits for grinding and whatnot. I have actually been enjoying the game again, questing, going to old places and just looking around like the good old days. I will admit, no where near the player base it used to have. I don't see anyone caging lobbies in Karamja or Harpooning swordies. I still love this game, it really brings me peace when FPS games just get too hectic sometimes.

I used to just bankstand and level up easy stats, but with UIM, you cannot do that, so it helps me set goals instead of camping the G.E for like 69 hours straight.
Anyway, thanks for reading, play this game if you like fantasy based games and aren't too turned off from the low graphics, a lot of people still play it for that appeal!

Do I recommend the game? Yes.
Having invested thousands of hours into the game I can say that this is addicting as all hell.
Watching your levels increase and unlocking new things never gets old.
The rush of getting that ultra-rare drop is unparalleled and getting them all is a lifetimes worth of gaming.
Once you start playing RuneScape you never quit, you only go AFK...

HOWEVER...

Do I recommend using the Steam client? No.
If you find yourself interested in OSRS do yourself a favour and go to Runelite.net and download the client there.
The game runs much better using that client not to mention all the QOL improvements that are present.
Jagex unfortunately has never seen fit to create/purchase/hire a game client that does anything more than let you play the game at it's base level.
Runelite unlocks some major graphical improvements and gives you the ability to track all sorts of things, your XP/hr, timed tasks like farming and birdhouse runs, sharing amazing drops with friends, helps with Quests, Clue Scrolls and so much more.

UPDATE 08/09/2021: Jagex is now working towards implementing many of Runelite's features into the Steam client and are doing a fantastic job of doing so. A few more key additions and I will make the transition to support the official client.
